deviations.basis: Frozen runner.py scale_cases sorts public JSON filenames lexically, rather than by physical size.
deviations.effect: The primary scale series measured 2048 m before some 256/512 m maps. All smaller maps were ultimately measured. This did not change endpoints, profiles, search limits or retained outcomes, but did not follow the requested ascending priority for that extension.
deviations.disposition: Keep raw measurements and expose exact map order in final-analysis.json. Treat main-series process peak as cumulative and times as descriptive in this order. Do not rerun or overwrite to conceal the deviation. The predeclared supplementary fresh-process memory series runs sizes in ascending order after all primary smaller-size measurements.

declared_design_interpretations.meaning: Ground-agent LHS coefficients are common across sizes for the same region/family/index. Endpoint, world and sensor streams include size; this pairing was recorded before the definitive sweep in implementation_assumptions.json. It is not a fully independent coefficient draw for every size.

The extent-only timing fixture keeps physical A/B fixed, approximately 45.25 m apart, outside the random-mission separation rule on large maps. It cannot establish kilometre-route performance. Actual broad/directed mission draws use the declared one-eighth to one-half interval without feasibility filtering.
